pairs.subject: multi-provider-gateway-plane
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/engine.rs:26 The daemon does not pick between upstreams itself: it gets a ready-made fleet from shadowrunr_engine::build_fleet, keeps one Arc<dyn Engine>, and serves its first-party console over RPC/websocket, so the tree of candidates, failover and failure attribution this subject governs are not in this context; a search of crates/shadowrunr-daemon for failover, strategy, loadbalanc and fallback_chain found no hits, and account picking with a tried-list (pick_account) is in crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/fleet.rs.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/engine.rs:14 The daemon holds one engine trait object and runs no candidate loop of its own, so there is no sweep for a router-failure marker to stop here; the account fallback loop is in the engine crate.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/config.rs:11 The routing/account config type is owned by the engine crate; the daemon only loads it and passes it on.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/config.rs:417 Accounts are operator-declared (label + config_dir), and the daemon only resolves their paths; it discovers no endpoints on a shared protocol and has no identities to probe.
